12.t: Working with data: stomata on leaves
q: Which plant has the most stomata?
On which surface does the bean have most stomata?
Explain why the water lily has stomata only on the top.
The lower surface touches water; gases come from the air above.
Explain how the oleander and cactus data show adaptations to dry places.
Few stomata, none on the sunny upper surface, sunken in pits: less water vapour escapes.
